method: Every cited source_url re-fetched with curl and text-matched (PDF via pypdf); quotes, values, organisational-vs-personal contacts and price sanity checked by hand; independent searches (web-search summaries used only as leads, every reported fact re-fetched) on the 12 least-covered/empty tracks (63%): Arima - National Cycling Centre; Barcelona - Velòdrom d'Horta; Bournemouth - Slades Park; Cali - Velódromo Alcides Nieto Patiño; Chun'an - Jieshou Velodrome; Dubai Sharjah Velodrome; Gera - Radrennbahn Gera; Kokura Media Dome; Lusail Shooting Club Velodrome; Medellín - Velódromo Martín Emilio Rodríguez; New Delhi - IGI Velodrome; Roubaix - Vélodrome André-Pétrieux. Chun'an, Dubai/Sharjah, Lusail: no official page found; researcher's not_found/needs_attention confirmed (existence of the venues remains unverified).
notes: The researcher's evidence field is often a description rather than a verbatim quote; values were judged against the page text itself.
Contacts: Gera club phone/email and Falun mobile rejected; Quibell council lines and Barcelona municipal-listing contacts verified but must go to needs-attention (medium confidence / council).
